exclusions.reason: Cover/contact/register information and authored date are provenance, not substantive clinical or policy-cost claims.

Rebate-group amendment, stabilisation priorities and expected future competition are proposals/forecasts. Broad difficult-finances language is a value assessment without a defined error threshold. Conditional supply mechanism and current price/model premises are separately inventoried.
Cover/date/contact information excluded as provenance; no delivery date inferred.

Preferred allocation to G-BA and proposed SGB V amendment are normative. The earlier advocacy reference and bibliography are not independent material claims about clinical truth; substantive present-law, burden and approval premises inventoried. No incidental citation-cleanup hunt.
Cover/board/contact/signatures and communication statements are provenance/incidental.
Welcoming timely promulgation, family benefit and demand-responsive supply are policy preferences and expected outcomes. Clinical suitability/comparison and legal scope separately assessed.
Cover identifies 20 August draft and 27 August author date; delivery remains unverified.

Class-based future-proof wording, reduction of administration and timely legal/billing certainty are recommendations or forecasts. Exact draft description, renewal mechanism and September timing assessed separately. Incidental ingredient spelling is not a finding.

Requested guaranteed coverage or maternal interim cover, assertion only legal change can solve it, and predictions of untreated/disadvantaged children are recommendations/forecasts. Conditional payment/access mechanisms retained with empirical prevalence limits. Earlier advocacy attribution is incidental to validity of the requested solution.
Contact/officeholder and lobby-register information incidental; not a new actor-denominator inference.

Salutation, process/date and gratitude incidental. Clinical burden and existing-general-benefit premises separately inventoried; all is read in the explicit GKV context, not literally all uninsured people.
Support for extension and expectation of better supply are policy judgments/forecasts. Clinical duration and first-season observational outcome assessed separately.
Cover and authored date only; no receipt or delivery inferred.

Stated goals to prevent severe outcomes and relieve capacity are legislative objectives, not promises of complete measured prevention. Approval of extension and desired alignment are normative; operative entitlement scope separately assessed.
Question whether ingredient list should be removed is a policy/legal-design proposal. No assertion that every future antibody will be approved, recommended or equally beneficial.
Cover/contact and authored date are provenance.

Potential future competition/savings and preferred numbered addition are forecasts/proposals. Current legal mechanism, shortage, approval and cost premises checked separately; no guaranteed competitive response inferred.
Desired timely prevention access and improved future framework are recommendations. Actual harm or guaranteed future delay is not inferred from conditional process mechanism.

STIKO-linked future ingredient-neutral entitlement, general SGB V amendment and administrative reduction are policy proposals/forecasts. Contact and register details incidental; no prediction converted into an error.

visual_checks.purpose: Full commencement paragraph and timing context inspected visually.
Exact Article 2 next-day commencement visually checked.

limitations: All 8 original statements and all 20 physical pages read before previous dispositions or any peer inventory; exact hashes and page counts independently checked.
Statements are a finite published set including statutory/self-government actors; no national or private-lobbyist denominator inferred. Rechecking adds no reading unit.
Authored dates differ from register/publication/delivery; vfa only gives September 2026. No receipt inferred. Exact dated August draft reused; no current October amendment silently substituted.

New background bytes are temporary; concise authored check notes retain URLs, date, locators, methods, limitations and hashes. Existing canonical original study/draft reused for exact-version dependencies.
Long clinical evidence reports read only at necessary methods/results/limitations passages, not expanded screening targets. No specialist confirmation, author contact or intent inference.

Clinical comparability is a broad therapeutic judgment with independent pre-author assessment, not direct head-to-head equality proof. Prices and administrative frequencies remain unresolved when matching data were unavailable.
One literal commencement discrepancy is recorded at low materiality with an explicit non-admission recommendation; no new substantive error candidate proposed.

nonadmission_decisions.reason: One-day draft-commencement description differs, but correction does not materially alter timely-access rationale. Do not admit a trivial main finding solely to increase yield.
